abstract: Ovarian tumors of germ cell origin consisted of 440 dermoid cysts, 5 struma ovariis, 3 immature teratomas (G1, G2), 2 carcinoids, 8 dysgerminoma, 3 yolk sac tumors, one choriocarcinoma, 4 dermoid cysts with malignant transformation, and one immature teratoma (G3) of a total of 1,387 ovarian tumors. The patients' mean ages ranged between 17.3 years to 31.9 years, but the mean ages of those with carcinoid and dermoid cyst with malignant transformation were 46.0 and 53.0 years, respectively. In dermoid cyst bilaterality was 17.3% and occurrence during pregnancy or puerperium was 19.6%. In benign tumors, torsion of pedicle and association with pregnancy or puerperium were frequent unlike common epithelial carcinoma, but ascites was rare. Abdominal tumor, pain and metromenorrphagia were the main symptoms, but abdominal distension was scarce with dermoid cysts. The rate of malignant transformation of dermoid cysts was 0.9% overall but 4.3% in patients over 40 years. The prognosis for borderline germ cell tumors was good.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞起源の卵巣腫瘍は、全1,387例の卵巣腫瘍のうち、類皮嚢腫440例、卵巣甲状腺腫5例、未熟奇形腫3例（G1、G2）、カルチノイド2例、ディスジャーミノーマ8例、卵黄嚢腫瘍3例、絨毛癌1例、悪性転化を伴う類皮嚢腫4例、未熟奇形腫（G3）1例であった。患者の平均年齢は17.3歳から31.9歳の範囲であったが、カルチノイドおよび悪性転化を伴う類皮嚢腫の患者の平均年齢はそれぞれ46.0歳と53.0歳であった。類皮嚢腫の両側性は17.3%、妊娠中または産褥期の発症は19.6%であった。良性腫瘍では、一般的な上皮性癌と異なり、茎捻転および妊娠・産褥との関連が多くみられたが、腹水は稀であった。主症状は腹部腫瘤、疼痛、過多月経・不正性器出血であったが、類皮嚢腫では腹部膨満は少なかった。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化率は全体で0.9%であったが、40歳以上の患者では4.3%であった。境界悪性の胚細胞腫瘍の予後は良好であった。
